summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the US-listed universe around the HBM/advanced DRAM/advanced-packaging chokepoint beyond the seed hyperscaler and accelerator names. The highest-direct-exposure additions are Micron for HBM and AI memory supply, Amkor for outsourced advanced packaging/test capacity, Teradyne for HBM/DRAM production test, FormFactor for probe cards and known-good-die enablement, and Onto Innovation for HBM/advanced-packaging inspection and metrology. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation. Expanded the US-listed universe around the HBM and advanced-packaging allocation chokepoint. The strongest directly mapped candidates are Micron for HBM supply, ASE Technology for advanced packaging and HBM/chiplet integration exposure, Teradyne and FormFactor for HBM test/probe bottlenecks, and Onto Innovation for HBM4 inspection/metrology. This pass excludes non-US-exchange leaders such as SK hynix and Samsung from the candidate list despite their central role, creating an explicit coverage gap. Expanded a focused US-listed universe around the HBM/advanced DRAM/advanced packaging chokepoint. The highest-relevance names are not only AI accelerator vendors, but also memory suppliers, outsourced advanced packaging providers, HBM test platforms, probe-card suppliers, and inspection/metrology vendors. This pass prioritizes companies with direct exposure to HBM qualification, package throughput, known-good-die workflows, and 2.5D/advanced packaging process control.
